'''EV-8D3''' was an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] who was figurehead of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], a group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that was focused on spreading [[Droid supremacy|violent rebellion]] against [[Species/Legends|organic]] life forms throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Debts to Pay" />
